fixes.new:
A tactics operator aboard the $$プトレマイオス２改$$. 16 years old.
Cheerful by nature, she could be called $$ソレスタルビーイング$$'s mood-maker. She has a distinctive way of speaking, ending sentences with '-desu' and addressing other members by 'surname + san.'
Having lived through the war, she has changed her hairstyle and grown more womanly, but her personality remains unchanged.
She is the daughter of $$イアン$$ and $$リンダ$$, and in times of crisis she sometimes shows off mechanical skills inherited from both her parents.
She harbors romantic feelings for $$ティエリア$$, and in front of her parents she confessed her feelings to $$ティエリア$$, who had become a being existing only as data within $$ヴェーダ$$: 'No matter what form you take, I love you, $$アーデ$$-san.'
In the final battle with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, when the $$プトレマイオス２改$$ was overrun by the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, she survived together with her parents.
fixes.reason: omission: the Japanese 披露する事もある says she 'sometimes' shows off her mechanic's skill; 'sometimes' was dropped and the tense changed to a past-experience reading

A mechanic for Celestial Being. 59 years old.
He handles not only maintenance but also the development of new Gundam models. The oldest member of the crew, he is deeply trusted by those around him, with $$ラッセ$$ affectionately calling him 'the old man.'
He continues to advance the development of Gundam-type mobile suits, using data fed back from the fighting against $$アロウズ$$ to develop the fifth-generation Gundams.

fixes.new:
A pilot belonging to the $$地球連邦軍#00$$. 34 years old. His rank is Major.
He has a history of service with the $$ユニオン$$ and $$アロウズ$$.
Ever since witnessing the $$エクシア$$'s first battle, he has been drawn to its performance and has repeatedly sought combat with the Gundams.
During his time with $$アロウズ$$, he lost subordinates in battle and suffered repeated defeats, until defeating the Gundams became the sole purpose of his life, and he took to hiding his identity while tracking them. Wearing a samurai-like mask and repeatedly making anachronistic pronouncements, he came to be called $$ミスター・ブシドー$$, a name he himself was not fond of.
He possesses extremely refined piloting skill, and is one of the few human $$ライセンサー$$s in $$アロウズ$$, closing the performance gap with the Gundams to fight them on more than equal terms.
He longs for a duel with $$刹那$$, who pilots a Gundam, and even upon recognizing that he himself has become a puppet of the $$イノベイド$$s, he holds fast to that desire.
Defeated by $$刹那$$ after $$刹那$$'s awakening as a pure-blooded $$イノベイター$$, he attempts to take his own life, but is stopped by $$刹那$$'s words. After the war he joins the $$地球連邦軍#00$$, serving as commander of the $$ソルブレイヴス$$ squadron.
Once known for his theatrical, distinctive manner of speech, he now draws on his past experiences, facing matters with a strong inner will and a rational attitude.
His friendship with $$ビリー$$ continues unchanged.
In the final battle with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, he kept fighting even as he lost subordinates, covered $$刹那$$ as he went to hold a dialogue with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, and, to clear the path ahead of him, made a suicide charge into the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ and died in battle.
fixes.reason: mistranslation: ガンダム打倒のみを生きる目的 = 'defeating/toppling the Gundams' was his sole purpose; 'pursuing' duplicates 追っていた (tracking them) later in the same sentence

fixes.new:
Former head of mobile suit development for $$アロウズ$$, now serving as a technical advisor to the Earth Federation Forces. 38 years old.
A student of Professor $$レイフ・エイフマン$$, an authority in mobile suit development, he previously served as technical advisor for the $$ユニオン$$'s $$ＭＳＷＡＤ$$.
After the fighting between $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ and the $$国連$$ forces ended, he unknowingly took in $$スメラギ$$, who had lost her place to go, letting her stay at his home.
When $$刹那$$ later appeared, $$ビリー$$ learned from him that $$スメラギ$$, the woman he had feelings for, was a member of $$ソレスタルビーイング$$, and driven by anger and resentment at feeling betrayed, he transferred to $$アロウズ$$.
He maintained an unchanged friendship with $$ミスター・ブシドー$$ (that is, $$グラハム$$) dating back to their days with the $$ユニオン$$, and developed the Trans-Am-equipped $$マスラオ$$ and $$スサノオ$$ for his sake.
In the decisive battle between $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ and the $$イノベイド$$s, he personally boards the $$プトレマイオス２$$ together with $$オートマトン$$. Though he comes face to face with $$スメラギ$$, the GN particles allow him to understand her true feelings, and the two reconcile.
After the war, he served as technical advisor, working on the development of the $$ブレイヴ$$.
His friendship with $$グラハム$$ has continued unchanged.
Aboard the $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ ship, he devoted himself to analysis and research of the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ together with $$ミーナ#pt169$$, was among the first to see through the characteristics of the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, and took part in countermeasures against it.
In the end he accepted the feelings of $$ミーナ#pt169$$, who had been pursuing him aggressively, and happily became her romantic partner.
fixes.reason: tense: 終戦後は技術顧問として、ブレイヴの開発を行なった is a completed past event; the English used present 'serves'

fixes.new:
A former $$アロウズ$$ pilot. 24 years old.
She once lived in a world untouched by conflict, an exchange student from Spain living in Japan, and she and $$沙慈$$ made a well-matched couple.
But when $$ネーナ$$'s whim cost her her parents, many relatives, and her own left hand, she broke with $$沙慈$$ and chose the path of revenge against the Gundams.
Born into a wealthy family, she funded $$アロウズ$$ with the large inheritance she received. Though her rank was only warrant officer, she enjoyed generous treatment from the higher-ups in various ways, from having her opinions heard to being issued new-model machines.
Her experience as a soldier was shallow and her lack of skill undeniable, and she suffered from cellular damage caused by past exposure to GN particles from a quasi-solar furnace, requiring her to take sedatives. Despite these problems, she threw herself into battle carrying her hatred of the Gundams.
$$リボンズ$$ took advantage of this, using her as a test subject to awaken artificial $$イノベイター$$s by continually administering her nanomachines in the form of a sedative. As a result, her body came to require regular sedative doses.
When she confronted $$沙慈$$ in person during the final battle, hatred and rage drove her into a deranged state, but the Trans-Am Burst let her and $$沙慈$$ understand each other, and she regained her sanity. The cellular damage that had been eating away at her body was also removed by the power of GN particles.
However, she has yet to overcome the aftereffects of the nanomachines $$リボンズ$$ administered to her and the PTSD from the war. Even two years after the war's end, she remains hospitalized, cared for by $$沙慈$$.
Sensing the approach of the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ at an early stage through the quantum brainwaves of the $$イノベイター$$s, she was terrified, and while being chased by a person resembling $$リボンズ$$ that the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ had mimicked, she was rescued by $$刹那$$ together with $$沙慈$$.
Afterward, from within a facility that blocks quantum brainwaves, she prayed for the safety of $$沙慈$$, who was heading to the space elevator to fight in his own way.
fixes.reason: mistranslation: 准尉 is warrant officer; 'ensign' is the corpus rendering of 少尉 (see pilots 182/183/186)

An $$イノベイター$$ who awakened as a pure strain.
A captain in the Earth Federation Forces, he is dissatisfied with being treated like a guinea pig, but reliably carries out every mission assigned.
In battle aboard the custom new mobile armor '$$ガデラーザ$$', he shows a fierce side, quite unlike his usual sarcasm.
When intercepting the massive swarm of the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ that appeared near Mars, he came under their encroachment, was driven into a deranged state by the enormous flood of information sent by the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, and was assimilated on the spot and died.
He described the voice of the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ as 'a scream echoing in the head', and never learned what it was saying.

fixes.new:
Captain of the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$. Rank of colonel. 45 years old.
Indecisive and somewhat unreliable at times, he is not held in much trust by the crew, including his executive officer $$レイアム$$.
Caught between the unclear intentions of his superiors and the crew in the field, he often vents his anger where no one can see.
But he is by no means incompetent - he looks out for $$ダグザ$$ and his men, who are often called 'manhunters' and viewed with suspicion.
Still, in situations he cannot avoid, such as the battle to retake $$パラオ$$, he steels his resolve and gives his all as captain.
His hobby is showing off his prized tea in the captain's quarters.
He survived the fighting over $$ラプラスの箱$$ together with his ship and his subordinates.
fixes.reason: mistranslation/addition: ダグザ達 = Daguza and his men (plural); マンハンターなどと呼ばれて = 'called manhunters'; 'dismissed as a mere manhunter' is not in the Japanese

fixes.new:
Commander of $$ロンド・ベル$$, an outer unit of the Earth Federation Space Forces. Rank of colonel. 36 years old.
After leading the $$ホワイトベース$$ during the $$一年戦争$$, he served as captain of one Gundam-type-carrying mothership after another, and is known as a commander of Newtype units.
His record has been viewed as dangerous, keeping him sidelined from the military mainstream, but his integrity in shutting out political influence and his wealth of combat experience have earned him the deep trust of his subordinates.
During the $$第２次ネオ・ジオン抗争$$, he led $$ロンド・ベル$$ and, together with his subordinate and close friend $$アムロ・レイ$$, stopped $$シャア$$'s plan to cool the Earth.
At the request of Representative $$ローナン・マーセナス$$, who sought to resolve the incident over the Box ahead of the $$ビスト財団$$, he set out in pursuit of the $$ガランシェール$$, which had descended to Earth.
When he learned that $$マーサ$$ and the rest of the $$ビスト財団$$ intended to use $$グリプス２$$ against $$インダストリアル７$$ in order to erase '$$ラプラスの箱$$', he seized $$シャイアン基地$$, its control base, and after the final battle ended, took $$マーサ$$ and the others into custody for questioning.
fixes.reason: mistranslation: 危険視され = regarded as dangerous, not 'a subject of suspicion'
